schema:
CREATE TABLE stores (store_id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, region TEXT NULL, opened_date DATE NULL);
CREATE TABLE monthly_metrics (store_id INTEGER NOT NULL, metric_date DATE NOT NULL, revenue INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (store_id, metric_date), FOREIGN KEY (store_id) REFERENCES stores (store_id));
correct_query: SELECT CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN T2.metric_date LIKE '2022-01-%' THEN T2.revenue ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.metric_date LIKE '2022-02-%' THEN T2.revenue ELSE 0 END)) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN T2.metric_date LIKE '2022-02-%' THEN T2.revenue ELSE 0 END) FROM stores AS T1 INNER JOIN monthly_metrics AS T2 ON T1.store_id = T2.store_id WHERE T1.opened_date = '2015-06-10'
